File name information:
All files are named story_a.b.c.
a indicates the stage in the story
b indicates which part of the stage (most stages only have one part, but some have multiple)
c indicates which part of the scene it is:
0 = before main scene
1 = main scene
2 = after climax

I am aware some stages are missing, I just did these in the order I felt like and I will be updating this in the coming days
